searches.reason: Develop controlled history-perturbation probes that distinguish specific recent intent from broad historical association. Compare truncation, order shuffling, recent-event removal, and matched irrelevant-event insertion; connect score changes to HSTU layers and training margins. Use paired controls and bootstrap intervals, without interpreting sensitivity alone as causal evidence.

searches.reason: Build evidence-aware probes for the reported redundant and incompatible recommendations using only titles, descriptions, and interaction timestamps. Investigate explicit attribute extraction and substitute/complement relationships, while reporting missing evidence separately from demonstrated mismatch. Validate extracted attributes on a small audited sample; do not infer satisfied needs or compatibility from purchases alone.

searches.reason: Establish whether diagnostics identify actionable ranking failures rather than merely describing training fit. Study candidate-sampling sensitivity, popularity and history-length strata, negative-sampling false negatives, and uncertainty. Keep the pinned host evaluator unchanged, and test diagnostic usefulness through controlled interventions within one HSTU model per category, using macro validation HR@10 for selection.
